items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: my mother's girlfriend... she said, 'Fanny, I'm going to go, I'm going to die.' She said, you take my children and raise them.

ctx.x: And my mother had 13 children, eight girls and five boys, and I was the 11th child, born in the 11th month, on the first day. And Herschel, that was my big brother, he was the second child. And my mother's sister, my mother had a girlfriend who (unintelligible), my mother's girlfriend, she took very sick and before she died she told my mother, she said, "Fanny, I'm going to go, I'm going to die." She said, you take my children and raise them. And mama took those children and raised them and one of her boys took…
